msc_rationale: The new theorem concerns periodic-point growth and periodic orbit enumeration of a synchronous local-update automaton on graphs, fitting the dynamical aspects of cellular automata in MSC2020 37B15.
scientific_integrity: All-size claims are proved mathematically; included finite computational checks are supporting evidence and not exhaustive beyond stated sizes.
scientific_limitations: Only initially periodic states under synchronous integer diffusion on labelled complete graphs are counted; transients and basins are not counted.
States are identified only by simultaneous integer translation, not vertex permutations.
The growth formula concerns graph order tending to infinity; no claim of new general period-two dynamics is made.
Historical priority beyond accessible primary texts, indexed searches, and accessible prior records remains uncertain.
title: Periodic-point growth of complete-graph diffusion
